content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: outage message, chat deflection, callback, break/coaching changes and overtime for 15 payments agents — predicted 81.4% service level for ₹3,795.","why":"The spike is driven by the UPI switch P1 incident (INC-20261006-6998): payments calls hit 213 vs 111.9 forecast, service level fell to 4.7% with 59 abandons, and upi_payment_failed calls are running 2.56x normal. Staffing and handle time are on plan, so the fix is to cut and absorb UPI demand. R1 is the cheapest policy-compliant plan that reaches the 80% target: 81.4% overall (payments 78.7%, general 85.2%), abandon rate down to 4.3% from 9.0% with no action. It moves no agents off general.","trade_offs":["P2 is cheaper (₹555) and compliant, but at 78.6% (payments 74.2%) it falls just short of the 80% target.","R2 reaches 86.5% (payments 85.3%) with 3.4% abandons, but costs ₹5,955, ₹2,160 more than R1, for headroom we don't strictly need.","P1 and P3 move 3 cross-skilled agents off general, dropping it to 40% and 66% during the move. Both breach the 70% floor (MOV-03), so they are ruled out. P1 also does worse than no action (68.2%).","Payments in R1 sits at 78.7%, slightly under 80%, while general carries the overall figure. Customer impact on payments is improved but not fully recovered."],"watch":"Watch payments service level and the overtime take-up from the 15 agents offered from 11:15. If take-up is low or the UPI incident runs past 12:30, consider stepping up to R2 (full overtime plus second break shift). Do not move agents off general. Once the incident is resolved, remove the IVR outage message promptly."}
